audit.whatIsWrong: The entire content layer used another champion's ability names: 'Twin Disciplines', 'Passage' and 'The Weird Fate' appear in whys[1], whys[4], whys[5], spikes[0], spikes[1], spikes[2], early, mid, late, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[0..2]. None of them belong to Aurora.
audit.why: Aurora's kit is Spirit Abjuration (P), Twofold Hex (Q, 900 range, 9s at rank 1, curse plus a recast that drags the curse home), Across the Veil (W, 700-unit leap into invisibility, 22s at rank 1), The Weirding (E, 825 blast, slow, backward hop, 15s) and Between Worlds (R, 250-unit leap, shockwave slow, then a slow zone she can teleport across, 140s at rank 1). The packet flags this exact defect: 'never names any of Aurora's abilities'.
audit.corrected: Every fabricated name replaced with the real one and the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].side, phases[5].side and phases[6].side all read 'Skill' while win[4] read 'Aurora' and win[5]/win[6] read 'Aurelion Sol' — three rows disagreeing across the two layers.
audit.why: Level 6 is Aurora's spike (Between Worlds); the first-item and two-item rows are Aurelion Sol's, which is where the 54.95% over 364 games comes from.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side to 'Aurora', phases[5].side and phases[6].side to 'Aurelion Sol', proposed as one atomic group and matching the content layer, which was already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] and late claimed a 'global Comet presence' and a '5-star ultimate'.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol has no global ability; Comet is a rune; the resource is stardust.
audit.corrected: Rekeyed to stacked stardust and The Skies Descend.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable interactions were absent: Spirit Abjuration heals her off the spirits her spells strip, and Between Worlds' CC cancels Breath of Light and Astral Flight.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions rules 'needs-antiheal' and 'your-channel-punished'; enemyKit P heal flag, R hardCC flag; ownerKit Q and W both interruptible channels.
audit.corrected: breakdown.carry now makes Grievous Wounds timing the carry plan; mid and breakdown.cooldowns state the channel cancel; early names the sustain.

audit.why: Across the Veil is 22s at rank 1 — the same clock as Astral Flight — and Between Worlds is 140s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with both and the matched-clock point.

edits.before: Aurora's Twin Disciplines passive alternates magic and physical damage on her poke, and Passage lets her hop through terrain to dodge your slow-traveling Q star while still landing her own harass. Your early kit simply doesn't out-range or out-trade her mobile poke pattern. Play for CS under minimal pressure, don't waste stars chasing a target that can blink through a wall, and wait out the poke phase.
edits.after: Twofold Hex curses you from 900 and recasts to pull the curse home, so she chips from outside your 750 beam, and Spirit Abjuration heals her back off every spirit she strips. Your early kit does not out-range or out-trade that pattern, and Grievous Wounds decides any long exchange. Play for CS, don't chase a champion who leaps invisible on a 22-second Across the Veil, and wait the poke phase out.

edits.before: The Weird Fate gives her a leash-and-follow mechanic that turns even a modest poke lead into a guaranteed all-in through terrain you can't block. You're still on the back foot here, relying on positioning and ability tracking rather than trading evenly. Respect her level 6 spike hard — don't extend near walls or brush where she can set up the ultimate combo, and look to group with jungler pressure instead of solo dueling.
edits.after: Between Worlds only leaps 250 units, but the zone it leaves behind slows you and lets her teleport from one side of it to the other — that is how a modest poke lead becomes a guaranteed all-in. Its CC also cancels your beam and your flight, so channel only once she has spent it. Respect the level 6 spike, never fight inside her zone, and group with jungler pressure instead of solo duelling.

edits.before: Once your first core item lands, your burst finally punishes her for over-extending Passage into your zone without support behind her. By two items your global Comet presence and 5-star ultimate outscale her mobile poke-and-burst kit, especially in fights that extend past her initial combo. Force extended engagements where her cooldowns run out and your scaling threat takes over the map.
edits.after: Once Rod of Ages lands, a held beam punishes her for leaping Across the Veil into your zone with no support behind her. By two items The Skies Descend and your stardust curve outscale her mobile poke-and-burst kit, especially in fights that run past her opening combo. Force long engagements where her 22-second hop is down and your scaling takes the map.

notes: This was the worst matchup in the slice: the whole content layer described a different champion. 'Twin Disciplines', 'Passage' and 'The Weird Fate' are not Aurora abilities in any form — her kit is Spirit Abjuration / Twofold Hex / Across the Veil / The Weirding / Between Worlds. Fourteen strings carried at least one of the three fabricated names; all are replaced. The Weirding (E) still appears nowhere on the page, but no remaining writable field could take it inside the length band without displacing a grounded fact — worth a follow-up pass. The packet's win-rate defect is only partly addressed: rows 5 and 6 now read Aurelion Sol in both layers, but levels 1-6 still go to Aurora, which the kit ranges support.
